name: web-botanical-mission-and-team-pages-lime-backdrop
title: Mission, FAQ and team pages of a botanical DNA site on a lime gradient
whatItIs: A pale lime board with a mobile column and three desktop pages. Pages have uppercase statement paragraphs with green words and inline icons, three cards with glass-sphere renders and a silhouette photo, a numbered FAQ accordion, value cards with a highlighted lime one, a row of cut-out scientists in white coats and a single expert profile.
whatItMeans: Warm and credible; scientists on white with green highlights feel clean and human.
techniques: Show team members as cut-out portraits in lab coats standing along the bottom edge.
Highlight one of a row of cards in lime.
Combine giant statements with a small side label.
Use glass-sphere botanicals as consistent illustration.

vocabulary.definition: Portraits without backgrounds arranged in a line.
The one card in a row given the accent tint.
A small block of text beside a large statement.
